ruled_out_vectors.vector: H1: Re-enter via transfer handler during swap to read stale reserves
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: TstorishReentrancyGuardWithFlags uses single ENTERED bit (bit 1) that blocks ALL reentry regardless of flag composition. _nonReentrantBefore checks `tload(SLOT) & ENTERED == ENTERED` — any nonReentrant-guarded entry point reverts if any other is active. CLOB handler has independent per-contract TstorishReentrancyGuard. No path to read stale reserves during swap.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H2: Multi-swap within hook callback overwrites transient slot mid-swap
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: multiSwap has nonReentrantWithFlags(MULTI_POOL_SWAP_GUARD_FLAG) — blocked by ENTERED bit if called during any active swap. directSwap similarly guarded. multiSwap only does pool swaps (not direct swaps), so DIRECT_SWAP_BEFORE_SWAP_AMOUNT_SLOT is not relevant.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H3: Native ETH refund during hook enables reentrancy to observe intermediate state
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: _depositWrappedNativeAndRefundExcess sends ETH after state updates, but reentrancy guard is still active (ENTERED). Any re-entry to AMM reverts. ETH transfer is 2300 gas (no complex callback possible). The call() at L3259 has no return data check (void) but is in the correct position.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H4: CLOB settlement callback reads AMM state before swap finalizes
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: In _finalizeSwapCollectFundsAndDisburse, handler runs at step 2 (ammHandleTransfer) AFTER pool reserves are updated (L1436-1443 in _poolSwapByInput). Output tokens sent at step 5. Callback (afterSwapRefund) runs at step 7. At no point does the handler see pre-swap reserves. The handler has its own nonReentrant guard.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H5: Trigger callback mid-state-update for external integrator arbitrage
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All external calls during swap (hooks, handlers) occur at well-defined points where state is consistent. Hook calls happen after fee calculations, reserve updates happen atomically in _poolSwapByInput. No mid-update callback exists.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H6: validateHandlerOrder missing sqrtPriceX96==0 check (computeRatioX96 overflow bypass)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Asymmetry confirmed: _validatePricingBounds (L847) checks sqrtPriceX96==0, validateHandlerOrder (L215-223) does not. However, through the CLOB path, calculateFixedInput preserves the ratio within uint160 bounds — computeRatioX96 does NOT overflow on the round-trip even at MAX_SQRT_RATIO with uint128.max amountIn. The bypass requires amount1/amount0 > 2^128 which is impossible through the calculateFixedInput derivation. No external callers besides _enforceTokenHooks that could inject arbitrary amounts.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H7: Function A writes partial state, call function B before A commits
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All AMM state updates (reserves, fee balances) happen atomically within _poolSwapByInput before any external callback. External calls (hooks) see complete state. No partial-write-then-callback pattern exists.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: H8: ETH transfer triggers 2300 gas callback with stale transient slot
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: ETH transfers use call{value: amount}('') with 2300 gas. Insufficient gas for any meaningful state read or tstore access. Reentrancy guard is active. Transient slots are per-contract isolated.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Mandatory Probe 1: Dust-loop extraction via 100+ tiny CLOB fills
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: CLOBHelper.calculateFixedInput uses mulDivRoundingUp (2 calls). Rounding is UP (maker-favorable). Max leak is 2 wei per fill. For 1M fills at adversarial price, total leak bounded by 2000 wei. Not economically exploitable. Pre-existing test CLOBRoundingExploit.t.sol confirms.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Mandatory Probe 2: Forged hook caller (call hook directly with fake pool identity)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: All state-changing hook functions gated by _requireCallerIsAMM() (beforeSwap, afterSwap, validateAddLiquidity, validatePoolCreation) or _requireCallerIsRegistry() (registryUpdate*). Non-state-changing functions are view/pure. validateHandlerOrder is external view — no state modification possible.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Mandatory Probe 3: Transient-slot theft (write slot in path A, read stale in path B)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Transient storage is per-contract isolated (EIP-1153). Reentrancy guard blocks concurrent swaps. _directSwap always calls beforeSwap (writes slot) then afterSwap (reads slot) in sequence (L1836-1838). Stale read only possible with misconfigured hook flags (beforeSwap disabled, afterSwap enabled) — self-inflicted config error, known FP #1.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Mandatory Probe 4: Permit mutation (replay signature with mutated unsigned feeOnTop fields)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Known FP (FP-SUB08). feeOnTop intentionally NOT in SWAP_TYPEHASH — signer protected by limitAmount which caps total expenditure. Previously submitted to Guardian Defender and rejected as Invalid. Cosignature also doesn't include feeOnTop but executor is a trusted relayer by design.

ruled_out_vectors.vector: Mandatory Probe 5: Storage-slot collision (facet writes to another facet's storage)
ruled_out_vectors.why_ruled_out: Diamond proxy pattern: all facets share LBAMMStorage struct at slot 0x9A1D via Storage.appStorage(). Same struct layout = no collision. Hooks/handlers called via regular call (not delegatecall) = separate storage contexts. Only admin can add facets (diamond cut). Storage collision requires admin deploying malicious facet — self-inflicted.

ModuleFeeCollection.collectHookFeesByHook (L60) has no nonReentrant but checks reentrancy flags to queue vs transfer. If called during active swap (ENTERED), fees are queued (not transferred). executeQueuedHookFeesByHookTransfers requires msg.sender == address(this). No path for external attacker to exploit the missing modifier — the flag-based branching provides equivalent protection.

theft_theses.thesis: Overflow computeRatioX96 to bypass validateHandlerOrder pricing bounds, place CLOB order at invalid price, fill it to extract from counterparty
theft_theses.victim: CLOB order makers who set max price bounds

theft_theses.thesis: Read stale transient storage from prior direct swap during CLOB settlement callback, compute wrong price, extract difference
theft_theses.victim: Direct swap counterparty or CLOB makers

theft_theses.thesis: Re-enter AMM during transfer handler callback to observe pre-finalization reserves, arbitrage the difference via flash loan
